scenes.headline: How LensVLM reads a long document as thumbnails
scenes.sub: Tiny page images, and one tool to open a page.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tamarind! Apple's LensVLM reads a long document as tiny page images, and opens only the pages it needs.

scenes.text: Shrink the pages until they are cheap, let the model find the page that matters, then hand it that page's original text.
scenes.say: Shrink the pages until they're cheap, let the model find the right one, then give it that page's real text.

parts.say: The encoder charges for area: sixteen pixel patches across the page,

parts.note: merged two by two, whatever is printed
parts.say: merged two by two. Print smaller, and every word gets cheaper.

scenes.title: Scan the thumbnails, open one page

steps.say: The document is printed onto small pages. A page costs seventy-two tokens at the lightest setting, twenty-four at the heaviest.
The model sees every thumbnail and the question. It can't read the words, but it can guess which page holds the answer.
It calls one tool, read page, and gets that page's original text back.
It can open more pages, then it answers. On average it opens one point three.

scenes.title: How it learned to pick a page

items.text: Keep the questions it gets wrong
items.say: Keep the questions the base model gets wrong.

items.text: A larger model writes the searches
items.say: A larger model writes a search for each, given the answer.
then reward right answers that used the tool.

scenes.label: effective compression at the heaviest preset, not a margin
scenes.note: the 15× preset, after the opened pages are added back
scenes.say: The reposted ten point one is a compression ratio: the heaviest preset, after the opened pages are added back.

scenes.title: Average accuracy at the heaviest preset
scenes.note: the retrievers read fewer tokens: 11.9× against 10.1×
scenes.say: There, the best text retriever ties it, fifty-two point one each, on fewer tokens. The clear wins come at lighter settings and on multi-hop questions.

scenes.text: Compressed pages are for finding the evidence. The original text is for reading it.

recap: Pages as tiny images, 24 to 72 tokens
Pick a page, then read its text
10.1× is a ratio, not a margin
scenes.say: To recap: tiny pages, one tool to open the right one, and a ratio that isn't a margin.
